targets.trigger: all user-visible date and duration consumers require the same invalid-value fallback

targets.pattern: page header, primary action, metrics, filters, tables, status regions, and pagination
targets.destination: web/src/components under the closest existing domain or layout family
targets.trigger: two real route consumers share the same behavior contract

targets.pattern: loading, empty, error, disabled, permission, and stale-state behavior
targets.destination: web/src/components or web/src/compositions according to whether the behavior is visual or headless
targets.trigger: the same state behavior is implemented in a second route family

targets.pattern: pagination, latest-request-wins, mutation reconciliation, or realtime subscription
targets.trigger: page-local state logic repeats or crosses route boundaries

targets.pattern: pull-request event recognition and Forge ref normalization
targets.trigger: repository PR list/detail and pipeline presentation must correlate the same real pipeline refs

targets.pattern: repository branch and pull-request detail header, latest pipeline summary, and history
targets.trigger: both real detail routes require the same information hierarchy over different reference identifiers

targets.pattern: repository settings navigation, section framing, dense table containment, and maintenance or danger action rows
targets.trigger: manual-run and the seven repository setting routes share the approved settings hierarchy while retaining distinct data and mutation contracts

targets.pattern: repository status badge URL and URL, Markdown, or HTML embed formatting
targets.trigger: badge route rendering and focused tests require one deterministic encoding contract

forbidden_dependencies: Shared atomic, form, and layout components importing route views.
Shared visual components importing typed API clients or Pinia domain stores.
Production code importing files from the approved standalone prototype.
Page-local styles introducing an independent token system.
review_rule: Record the reused, created, or extracted component in the owning task report before marking that task complete.
